newsitem.title: USA: Au Bon Pain sees 60 new units in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Au Bon Pain sees 60 new units in 1997.

text.p: Au Bon Pain Co Inc said on Tuesday it expected to open 40 new Saint Louis Bread company and franchise-operated locations and another 20 Au Bon Pain franchise-operated units in 1997.

The company, which said it also planned to remodel a number of existing Au Bon Pain stores, said its new Saint Louis Bread prototype has delivered sales exceeding expectations and would be the model for new such 1997 units.

In the third quarter, Au Bon Pain said comparable restaurant sales at Saint Louis rose 11.5 percent, compared with the same period last year, but comparable restaurant sales at the Au Bon Pain business unit fell 2.5 percent against last year's third quarter.

Sales growth at the Saint Louis unit was driven by continued stong acceptance of the sourdough bagel program introduced at the start of 1996 and improvements in operational execution, the company said.

"We have been testing the Saint Louis Bread sourdough bagel program in the Au Bon Pain stores and it will be rolled out in the first quarter 1997," said Ron Shaich, co-chairman and chief executive officer.

The company also said Robert Taft had been named president of the Au Bon Pain unit and the company was testing a remodeled Au Bon Pain, with an emphasis on creating a late-afternoon gathering place, it said.
